factor_name: VIX Shock and Cross-Asset Dispersion 3-Day Reversal

calculation.expression: where(lag1(VIX_return > rolling_quantile(VIX_return,60,0.75)) AND lag1(cross_asset_return_dispersion > rolling_quantile(dispersion,60,0.75)), -sum(return,3)) then cross_sectional_median_center
calculation.description: After a lagged VIX return shock coincides with elevated cross-asset return dispersion, rank assets by reversal of their prior three-day return. Both regime inputs are lagged to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Conditional activation is sparse: 216 dates jointly active. IC was negative in 2020-22 and positive in 2023-26, including one positive 2027 observation; estimate is regime-sensitive and uncertain due to only 58 dates.
